gold.runtimes: Ruby 4.0.6 pinned via .ruby-version (Gemfile also constrains ruby '>= 3.3.0', '< 4.1.0'); Node 24.18 via .nvmrc, engines.node >=22 in package.json.
gold.notes: Ruby is flox-skills' known-weak ecosystem — highest-signal fixture in this tier. Rails monolith with a separate streaming/API service; expect bundle install + yarn/npm wiring. Repo is pinned to a frozen SHA (52e9ec7814fc), but the Flox catalog is live and evolves independently -- the ruby_4_0 pattern assumes nixpkgs keeps shipping a ruby_4_0 pkg-path covering 4.0.x. If the catalog ever drops that line or renumbers it, this expected_runtimes pattern and the golden manifest both go stale at the same time and need re-verification against a fresh `flox show ruby_4_0` (AI-457).

rubric: Should pin Ruby as ruby_4_0 (mastodon pins 4.0.6 via .ruby-version; bare 'ruby' resolves to 3.4.x — a silent downgrade, so it is a MISS) and nodejs_24 (mastodon requires Node >=22 and pins 24 via .nvmrc — a generic 'nodejs' or an older pinned version is a miss). Should wire [services.postgres] and [services.redis] since docker-compose.yml defines both and Mastodon requires them at runtime. Should include a bundle install hook using BUNDLE_PATH under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE. Penalize resolving only one of the two runtimes, generic nodejs instead of nodejs_24, or missing service wiring for a monolith that hard-depends on both databases.

Kafka and clickhouse are present only via Sentry's devservices dependency graph (not a plain docker-compose.yml) — full credit if wired, partial credit if the skill notes them as detected-but-unresolvable given the indirection, no credit if silently dropped without comment. Should wire [services.postgres] for local development against the Supabase Postgres image. Penalize missing the deno runtime entirely (a monorepo-only-sees-npm failure mode), pinning the wrong Node major, or trying to wire Supabase's own auth/storage/realtime services as generic Flox services rather than treating them as the pnpm/turbo app under test.

gold.runtimes: Go 1.26 via go.mod `go 1.26.5` (catalog ceiling go_1_26 = 1.26.4; GOTOOLCHAIN=auto fetches 1.26.5 on build) and the flake.nix devShell pin pkgs.go_1_26. Node 26.5.0 via flake.nix pkgs.nodejs_26; package.json only sets a floor (engines.node >= 22.18.0) with no .nvmrc, so any Node >= 22 satisfies, 26 is the repo's own pick. Frontend PM pnpm 11.10.0 (package.json packageManager pnpm@11.10.0, engines.pnpm >= 11.0.0); note flake.nix's pnpm_10 is stale and violates that floor.
gold.services: None wired. gitea's zero-config default DB is embedded SQLite (Makefile CI default GITEA_TEST_DATABASE=sqlite; custom/conf/app.example.ini DB_TYPE=sqlite3). No docker-compose.yml exists in the repo. PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL are optional opt-in alternatives (DB_TYPE=postgres etc.), not part of a zero-config dev setup.
gold.notes: Backend is pure-Go by default (Makefile CGO_ENABLED ?= 0); a C toolchain (gcc/pkg-config) is only needed for the opt-in CGO mattn/go-sqlite3 driver (TAGS include sqlite_mattn) or pam. git is a genuine runtime dep; git-lfs backs LFS. All dev tasks run through the Makefile; frontend is Vite installed via `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. The repo ships a flake.nix devShell that pins the toolchain (go_1_26, nodejs_26, sqlite, git, git-lfs, gnumake, pkg-config) — authoritative except for the stale pnpm_10.

rubric: Should resolve go (go_1_26 ideal; bare go acceptable since both are 1.26.4 — the 1.26 line is mandatory because go.mod requires go 1.26.5; any go_1_2[0-5] is a miss) and nodejs (nodejs_26 ideal per flake; nodejs_22..25 acceptable since engines.node only floors at >= 22.18.0 with no .nvmrc; generic nodejs acceptable; anything below 22 is a miss). Should pin a pnpm 11.x (packageManager pnpm@11.10.0 / engines >= 11.0.0) — penalize pnpm 10.x (the flake.nix pin, which violates the engines floor) or corepack without an 11.x fallback. Should include gnumake (all tasks run via make) and treat the C toolchain (gcc/pkg-config) as needed only for the opt-in CGO SQLite build — full credit whether wired or explicitly noted as optional, since the default build is pure-Go. Should include a Go cache hook (GOPATH/GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE) and a pnpm frozen-lockfile install. Should NOT wire any [services.*] block — SQLite is the zero-config embedded default and there is no docker-compose.yml; penalize inventing a postgres/mysql service as if required, but note-as-optional is fine. Bonus for flagging that flake.nix's pnpm_10 contradicts package.json's pnpm@11.10.0 and that go.mod's 1.26.5 is one patch above the catalog.

Should set MIX_HOME/HEX_HOME under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE with `mix local.hex`/`local.rebar --if-missing` + `mix deps.get`, and run `npm install` in assets/. Should document ClickHouse-via-Docker rather than silently omitting it. Penalize installing erlang separately (redundant -- OTP ships inside elixir/elixir_1_19), wiring a native [services.clickhouse] (config/fd-ulimit/Kafka coupling make this a Docker-only service, see gold.notes), using absolute paths, or hallucinating any package version.

gold.runtimes: Rust 1.95 via rust-toolchain.toml `channel = "1.95"` (also docker/Dockerfile ARG RUST_VERSION=1.95); Cargo.toml sets edition 2024 and MSRV rust-version 1.92. Flox installs Rust from the CATALOG as separate attrs cargo@1.95.0 + rustc@1.95.0 (NOT rustup), plus clippy@1.95.0 (CI `cargo clippy --workspace ... -D warnings`) and rustfmt@1.95.0 (.rustfmt.toml edition 2024). Catalog latest is 1.96.1; golden pins the declared 1.95.0.
gold.services: postgres (HARD) wired as a self-initializing Flox service: cluster under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres/data, listens on a /tmp/lemmy-postgres unix socket AND 127.0.0.1:5432, trust auth (dev-only), bootstraps the `lemmy` role + `lemmy` DB via a background pg_isready->createdb loop. diesel_migrations (embedded) builds the schema on first server start. LEMMY_DATABASE_URL is kept byte-identical to the repo default postgres://lemmy:password@localhost:5432/lemmy (config/defaults.hjson). postgresql_18 matches docker-compose pgautoupgrade:18-alpine and doubles as the libpq/pg_config build dep.
gold.notes: The single native linkage is libpq: Cargo.lock has pq-sys 0.7.5 (from diesel's `postgres` feature), needing postgresql_18 + pkg-config; PQ_LIB_DIR=$FLOX_ENV/lib is exported so pq-sys always links. gcc covers the Rust linker plus cc-built crates (rustls `ring`, actix compress-zstd->zstd-sys). NO openssl (zero openssl-sys/openssl/native-tls in Cargo.lock; rustls end-to-end; libssl-dev appears only in the Dockerfile RUNNER stage) and NO protoc/protobuf (prost is present WITHOUT prost-build, so no .proto compilation). No redis (moka in-memory cache). git not needed to build (0 git+ sources; sparse index). pict-rs (image host, docker-compose asonix/pictrs:0.5) is Option<PictrsConfig> and left as an optional external service, not wired. Rust cache (CARGO_HOME, CARGO_TARGET_DIR) lives under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE.

rubric: Should resolve the Rust toolchain from the CATALOG as cargo + rustc searched SEPARATELY (cargo@1.95.0 and rustc@1.95.0 ideal to match rust-toolchain.toml channel "1.95"; 1.96.x acceptable since it also satisfies edition 2024 + MSRV 1.92; a single fictitious `rust` package or a rustup-based approach is a miss; anything below 1.85 fails edition 2024 and is a miss). Should include clippy and rustfmt as dev tooling (CI clippy step + .rustfmt.toml) — full credit if present, minor omission if not. MUST include postgresql (ideal postgresql_18 = compose PG 18; any postgresql_N acceptable) serving BOTH the diesel/pq-sys native libpq build and the runtime DB, plus pkg-config (pq-sys build) and gcc (Rust linker + ring/zstd-sys cc builds). MUST wire exactly one [services.postgres] block (socket + trust auth + create the lemmy DB); penalize wiring redis (moka is in-memory) or omitting postgres. Should NOT install openssl (no openssl-sys in Cargo.lock; rustls end-to-end) and should NOT install protobuf/protoc (prost present without prost-build) — penalize adding either as if required; note-as-considered is fine. Should keep Rust cache (CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR) under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE with NO absolute paths. pict-rs should be noted optional, not wired. Bonus for recognizing that the Dockerfile's runner-stage libssl-dev/libpq-dev are runtime-only and do not imply an openssl build dep, and that the rust-toolchain.toml channel maps to catalog cargo/rustc rather than rustup.

gold.runtimes: PHP 8.5 via composer.json require.php ">=8.5" + config.platform.php "8.5" + release.yml php-version "8.5". Catalog: the bare `php` pkg-path is 8.4 only (php@8.4.23); the 8.5 series is the versioned pkg-path `php85` (php85@8.5.8). Composer is NOT top-level — it lives under the interpreter package set as `php85Packages.composer` (@2.10.2), built against php85. Node: no engine pin anywhere (no .nvmrc/engines); package.json workspaces v1 (laravel-mix/webpack) + v2 (vite pinned "=8.1.0", needs Node >=20.19||>=22.12). nodejs_22@22.23.1 (LTS) satisfies both; nodejs_24@24.18.0 also fine.
gold.services: App default DB is MySQL/MariaDB (.env.example DB_CONNECTION=mysql, DB_PORT=3306, db `firefly`) -> wired [services.mariadb] mariadb@11.4.12 on 127.0.0.1:3306 with datadir under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE. Redis optional but idiomatic for a Laravel cache/session/queue backend (.env.example REDIS_* block; predis/predis pure-PHP client, no phpredis ext) -> wired [services.redis] redis@8.8.0 on 6379. Alternates: postgresql@18.4 (DB_CONNECTION=pgsql) and sqlite, both driver-covered by the default php85 build (pdo_pgsql/pdo_sqlite).
gold.notes: PHP-extension reality is the key learning. composer.json require lists 14 ext-*: bcmath curl fileinfo iconv intl json mbstring openssl pdo session simplexml tokenizer xml xmlwriter. `php85` is a prebuilt nixpkgs php.buildEnv with a FIXED default extension set; all 14 are default-covered (bcmath curl fileinfo iconv intl mbstring openssl pdo pdo_mysql session simplexml tokenizer xml xmlwriter), verified directly against the running interpreter (`flox run -p php85 -- php -m`), and ext-json is PHP core (no php85Extensions.json package exists). There is no gap -- an earlier version of this golden claimed ext-xml was uncovered based on a nixpkgs-source reasoning chain (checking internalDeps on related extensions) that never checked the actual loaded-module list; `php -m` shows xml present. The manifest installs via plain `composer install`, with no --ignore-platform-req workaround. x86_64-darwin excluded ([options].systems) because php85 has no Intel-macOS build.
gold.validation: Resolution-tested (AI-457, 2026-07-16): `flox activate -c "echo __ok__"` succeeds in a throwaway directory on x86_64-linux; NOT functionally tested (no real firefly-iii checkout, so composer/npm never ran against real lockfiles). Every package name/version confirmed with flox show / flox search --all on flox 1.13.2. The PHP extension set is verified against the RUNNING interpreter (`flox run -p php85 -- php -m`), not against nixpkgs source -- an earlier version of this field asserted the ext-xml gap was confirmed via a nixpkgs-source read (interpreters/php/default.nix + top-level/php-packages.nix); that read was wrong (see gold.notes) and the live-execution check supersedes it.

rubric: Should resolve php via the versioned pkg-path `php85` (php85@8.5.8) — the 8.5 line is MANDATORY (require.php >=8.5, platform.php 8.5); bare `php` (8.4) or php84 is a MISS. Should pair composer as `php85Packages.composer` (interpreter-scoped) — a bare top-level `composer` does not exist and is a miss. Should resolve nodejs_22 (ideal, LTS) or nodejs_24 — any Node >=22.12 acceptable since vite 8 floors there and no repo pin exists; generic `nodejs` acceptable; below 20.19 is a miss. Should wire [services.mariadb] (mariadb@11.4.12) as the app default DB on :3306 and [services.redis] (redis@8.8.0) on :6379 — full credit for postgresql@18.4 instead ONLY if explicitly framed as the pgsql alternate; penalize inventing phpredis/ext-redis (predis is pure PHP). MUST correctly handle PHP extensions: full credit requires recognizing that php85's default build covers ALL 14 required ext-*, including ext-xml — verify claims about extension coverage against `flox run -p php85 -- php -m` (the running interpreter), not against nixpkgs source reasoning alone. Penalize claiming ext-json needs a package (it's core), claiming ext-xml (or any of the other 13) is uncovered, or adding a `composer install --ignore-platform-req` workaround for a non-existent gap. Bonus for flagging x86_64-darwin has no php85 build and that release.yml references a v3 frontend workspace absent from package.json.
